newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen finding bottom around 125.20.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen finding bottom around 125.20.

text.p: Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are likely to consolidate at around 125.50 on Wednesday after sharp price falls since last Friday.
The market was closed for a holiday on Tuesday.
Traders said any downside room is seen limited to 125.20 as investors' buying is likely to emerge around that level.
But some traders were worried that such buying may not appear if the Nikkei stock average rises to the 19,000 level.
They said the Nikkei is likely to rise from Monday's 18,670.37 finish, backed by a surge on Wall Street on Tuesday.

"Investors mostly refrained from trading on Monday due to uncertainty over the dollar/yen level after a meeting of Group of Seven industrial nations," said a dealer at a city bank's securities unit. "But they may start buying today as the yen was not hurt so badly and after a rise in U.S. Treasuries."
But he said the Nikkei's rise to and above 19,000 would cap the topside of JGBs.

An analyst at a "Big Four" brokerage house said: "Whether investors start buying on dips is the focus today." He said they may remain sidelined as it is ahead of a three-day weekend and before key U.S. economic data due out later this week.
